Number of participants who completed a MItra conversation
Denominator for every % below. Track partial completions separately — where people drop off tells you if 10 turns is still too long.
Breakdown of respondents by role / org type (practitioner, funder, researcher, government, civil society, philanthropy, academia, edtech, social entrepreneur)
Diversity = credibility. Classify at report time from the open answer; the bot never asks a clarifier.
Number of countries and Indian states represented
Q1 asks role + org + location in one turn.
% who attended 2+ editions; % who attended all 5
PRE-FILL from the registrant record (fallback: post-close tap)

AT RISK — editions-attended no longer has a conversational turn. This metric only exists if the survey link carries a respondent token, or a post-close tap collects it. If neither ships, reinstate the question and drop Q5.
Clustered themes of the one belief or idea that shifted — and, for non-shifters, what would have made a difference
Qualitative. Cluster at analysis time; also a source of pull-quotes.
NEW — the probe now yields both branches
# respondents who initiated a collaboration through InvokED
# respondents with a collaboration in progress
Report separately from 'initiated' — do not merge them to inflate the headline.
Of all collaborations reported, the split between partners MET AT InvokED and partners the respondent ALREADY KNEW (plus 'a mix')

NEW HEADLINE METRIC — and the most defensible number in the whole report. 'X collaborations happened after InvokED' is weak; 'X collaborations began with someone they met at InvokED' is causal. Lead with this.
Breakdown by type: co-creation / pilot / knowledge exchange / funding / advisory
Coded at report time from the open answer — the bot does not read out a list.
# collaborations spanning different sectors / persona types
Derived: match the named partner org to a sector, compare against the respondent's own.
# pilots or missions launched off the back of InvokED
A subset of collaboration types; probe 3 confirms whether it actually launched or is still intent.
% whose organisation's approach shifted moderately / significantly
Among respondents who answered No: what they still want to take forward, and what is blocking it
NEW — turns the No branch from a dead end into the lead list for InvokED Forums. Cluster the barriers; they are your programme design input.
Whether respondents stayed connected with InvokED peers
Q3 probe 1 (Yes branch — partners named) + Q3 probe 3 (No branch — 'anyone you're still in touch with')

REDEFINED — v1 asked everyone a single 'stayed connected: actively / occasionally / no' question, so it produced one clean %. That question is gone. The new sources are branch-specific and qualitative, so report it as a NAMED-CONNECTION COUNT, not a percentage. Do not publish a % that implies everyone was asked the same thing.
Retention signal for the next edition.
Ranked preference across forums / online problem-solving / thematic meet-ups / knowledge resources
Shapes the engagement offer. Q5 merges return intent and format preference into one turn.
Clustered themes of how senior education leaders actually define 'future readiness'
NEW — the narrative asset. Treat as source material for the sector narrative, NOT as a representative measure: n=150–250 senior leaders is not the million-voices sample.
What respondents say they are concretely doing to advance it
NEW — pairs with the definitions to show the gap between how the field talks about future readiness and what it is actually doing.
# high-value connectors, active collaborators and potential forum leaders flagged
Cross-reference: people who both collaborated AND want year-round formats are your forum leaders.
# willing to share their experience (written / video)
No longer a conversational turn. Ships as a tick-box after the conversation ends, with the photo upload.
# nominations + self-nominations for the Shikshagraha Awards
Same as above. If the post-close screen doesn't ship, this metric does not exist.
METRICS THAT NO LONGER EXIST — do not build a tile for these
The pre-InvokED attitude to collaboration, as a measurable starting point

The baseline question was the first thing cut (most expensive per unit of insight from a time-poor audience). Perception shift is now SELF-REPORTED magnitude, not a measured before/after. Say so in the report methodology — do not imply a measured delta.
'% staying connected (actively + occasionally)' across all respondents
The universal question that produced this number is gone. Reporting a % from branch-specific probes would be dishonest.
